text:
mira: Heads-up — planning a cross-service cutover tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Runtime -> Router -> API -> Console. Need deploybot wave and a brief pin for API schema.
kevin: timeline? how long per step?
jordan: propose: runtime canary 5% for 10m, router warmup 5m, api canary 10m, console toggle off for canary then full roll.
mira: Can we add a soft pin on API schema to prevent auto-roll during the window? If runtime signals mismatch we fallback to api:v2-compat.
deploybot: @mira Deploy scheduled: 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Waves: runtime->router->api->console. Canary config attached. :robot_face:
samir: KV cache note — new runtime evicts older caches. Need an explicit evict step between runtime and router to avoid 500s. Ops please coordinate.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Route quiesce required before header flip.
kevin: Rollback plan: revert router header swap + pin API back to api:v1-stable, runtime image rollback to runtime:stable-20260328. Manual trigger on failure.
mira: Drop release notes link here: https://intranet.redwood/release/7712345678 (short summary + rollback commands).
jordan: Add healthcheck probe: /healthz?full=true post-deploy, failfast=3. If probes fail, abort wave and run rollback.
samir: I'll own the rollback steps and be on standby in the channel.
deploybot: Preflight checks passed: infra quotas OK, canary pool healthy, pinned variants available.
kevin: One more ask — disable console UI heavy features during canary to keep load down. Toggle via feature-flag at step 4.
mira: Agreed. Console flag will be disabled by default and re-enabled after full rollout.
jordan: Updating deploybot runbook with pins and rollback commands:

```
# rollback runtime
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/runtime runtime=runtime:stable-20260328 --record
# pin api back
redwood pin api --service=payments --version=api:v1-stable --reason="rollback"
# router header revert
redwood router set-header-policy --policy=legacy
```

mira: Last call for objections.
kevin: No objections, +1.
samir: +1.
mira: Ok scheduling to proceed. Ping here when starting the run.
ops-bot: Deploybot will post wave start and step markers in this thread when it begins.
